blocks.html:
ZAHRA’S DESIGN STUDIO is a craft company that cre­ates creative cross stitch kits, unique patterns and joy­ful workshops. We were established in 2022 by Zahra Al-lawati, from her love of Palestinian embroidery. Her aim was to recreate the heritage patterns to a modern and simple designs.

Our designs are crafted in our studio in Muscat, Oman. Our products and workshops are suitable for both be­ginners and experienced stitchers.

All of our kits include high quality materials and easy to un­derstand tutorials, The kits come in a box with everything you need to complete your cross-stitch project.

Embroidering my wedding dress was always a dream of mine. It was an incredible journey, and I learned so much along the way. Now, I can proudly say, "My wedding dress was designed and embroidered by me."

Zahra Al-lawati

Zahra Al-lawati is an experienced embroidery and cross-stitch trainer who loves sharing her skills with others. She has trained over 200 people through both online and in-person workshops. Zahra makes learning fun and easy by teaching techniques that combine traditional styles with modern ideas. Her workshops are friendly and hands-on, helping trainees build confidence and enjoy the art of embroidery and cross-stitch.

The workshops begin with an introduction to the art, where participants explore the tools and practice the basic stitches. Each student then works on their own project to apply what they have learned during the session.

If you're interested to join one of Zahra's workshops, you can join our WhatsApp list Click here to get the announcement and all the details about our upcoming workshops when they're out.
Got suggestions or just want to say hello? Reach out to us anytime!
At Zahra’s Design Studio, we focus on designing, experimenting and assembling to create unique kits.

Our cross-stitch patterns are designed to make stitching fun and enjoyable. They are easy to follow, with clear instructions and detailed charts to guide you every step of the way. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced stitcher, our patterns make embroidery simple and rewarding.

items.question: Are your kits made for total beginners?
items.answer: Absolutely! We have beginners and intermediate kits. All beginner’s kits are designed for total beginner with a step-by-step guide to teach all the basics you will need and all kit patterns are easy to follow.

items.question: Why don’t you offer printed patterns?
items.answer: Our customers enjoy the flexibility of PDF patterns so they can choose to use them on a desktop, laptop, tablet or mobile device and zoom in. They can choose to print the patterns if they wish.

items.question: Can you design a custom pattern for me?
items.answer: Yes, we accept custom patterns. Please fill this form, we will review your request and get in touch with you via WhatsApp within 2 working days.

items.question: Can I sell the work once it is complete?
items.answer: Yes, you can sell your finished work, however, please do not sell, claim our pattern as your own, or use our photos.

items.question: Can I order a kit or handmade product as a gift?
items.answer: Yes! Please mark your order as a gift check out checkout, you can also include a gift note. If you would like to ship the gift directly to them, please enter their name, address, email and phone number when placing the order.

items.question: How do I apply I discount code?
items.answer: On the final checkout page, there is a box on the top of the page, above the billing detail in which you can enter any active discount code, and it will be automatically applied. Please note, discount codes cannot be combined with any other offers.
